messages.subject: bcfa Error : object 'data' not found
parts:
I keep getting an error while trying to run bcfa() saying that blavaan cannot find the data object. 

I am using blavaan version 0.5-2 and R version 4.3.2.

I have included my code below and attached the dataset.

Please advise.

Thanks!

------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------
Code:

model.combined.ses = '
              CE =~ cenmup_i + nbaa + nbva
              AV =~ vsspnr_i + lcspnr_i + vsspnw_i + lcspnw_i + bndvbw + bndcmbw + dgspnr_i + bndpbsw
              PL =~ plnwww + dgspnw_i + bndpbsw + bndcmbw + dgspnr_i
             
              CE ~~ AV
              CE ~~ PL
              AV ~~ PL
             
              CE ~ yrsmomed
              AV ~ yrsmomed
              PL ~ yrsmomed'

priors.ses <- dpriors(
 
  nu="normal(0,5)",         # intercepts
  lambda="normal(1,5)",     # loadings
  theta="gamma(1,1)[prec]", # observed variable precision
  psi="gamma(1,1)[prec]",   # latent variable precision
  rho="beta(1,1)",          # latent variable correlation
  beta="normal(1,5)"        # loadings
)

n.chains = 6
n.warmup = 1000
n.burnin = 0
n.iters.per.chain.after.warmup.and.burnin = 5000
n.iters.total.per.chain = n.warmup+n.burnin+n.iters.per.chain.after.warmup.and.burnin

multigroup.invariance.scalar.ses <- bcfa(
  model.combined.ses,
  dp=priors.ses,
  n.chains=n.chains,
  burnin=n.warmup,
  sample=n.iters.per.chain.after.warmup.and.burnin,
  mcmcfile=TRUE,
  bcontrol=list(cores=n.chains),
  inits="simple",
  data=all_scaled_SES,
  group="group",
  group.equal = c("loadings","intercepts")
)

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: bcfa Error : object 'data' not found
parts:
Deanne,

This code works for me on version 0.5-2. I am wondering whether restarting R with a clean workspace would help. This is because I am not quite sure how this error could be produced by bcfa(). For example, you get the "not found" error by typing a variable that doesn't exist:

> no123
Error: object 'no123' not found

But if you run bcfa() without the "data" argument or use a dataset that doesn't exist, you get a different error.

If restarting doesn't help, maybe it would help to see your commands for loading the csv file into R, or to see your sessionInfo().

Ed
